stem: Which of the following describes a difference between the article and the poem?

options.label: A
options.text: The article provides details of an event related to spitting cherry pits, while the poem describes the process of spitting cherry pits.

options.label: B
options.text: The article provides information about activities that occur before a contest, while the poem describes the results of a contest.

options.label: C
options.text: The article focuses mainly on the people who spit cherry pits, while the poem features those who observe the activity.

options.label: D
options.text: The article explains how to organize a local competition, while the poem highlights how to get involved in one.
